analysis:
This PR changes documentation only: docs/provider/cli-reference.md (one bullet at head line 1025, outside the supplied excerpts apart from the surrounding text) and docs/reference/provider-authorization.md (new paragraphs at head lines 92-107). Unit 5e981ab2e8a7b18a:0 is a metadata-only unit for the same file with no content to examine. No code or control changes are included.

The docs describe a status/doctor display change in ProviderAuthorizationReadiness. It keeps showing an App Attest serving lease until its expires_at, even if the latest renewal arrived more than snapshotMaxAge ago. None and legacy decisions still require a fresh receipt. The strict MDM-removal decision stays separate: positive removal advice requires a matching fresh decision and mdm_removal_ready. The summary asks for fresh readiness and retains profiles when the lease is late but unexpired, and unenroll re-checks readiness before and after profile inspection.

Threat-model relevance is T-053, T-052, T-057 and A-016. The documented behavior does not turn the display into serving authorization: lease expiry still bounds it, and removal advice remains gated on a fresh coordinator decision. That is consistent with the fail-safe direction.

The remaining integration question is whether ProviderAuthorizationReadiness.displayedStatus and summary are implemented as documented. A displayed lease must not feed unenroll or removal gating, and the coordinator must remain the authority over lease duration. The implementation source is not in this batch, so I cannot verify it. The unchanged cli-reference text reviewed (for example the DARKBLOOM_APP_ATTEST_WORKER_QUALIFICATION opt-in forwarded only when exactly 1) matches the TB-011 default-off worker boundary. No threat-model update appears necessary from the docs alone.
